title: Explicit Drop Syntax
goal: Use `std::mem::drop` instead of calling destructor methods directly.
hints: Rust forbids explicit calls to `Drop::drop` methods.
Pass the owned value to a standard memory function instead.
explanation: Calling `buf.drop()` or `Drop::drop(&mut buf)` fails with `E0040` because direct calls would lead to double-free errors when the variable scope ends. `std::mem::drop(buf)` takes ownership of `buf`, allowing it to fall out of scope inside the function body safely.
